messages.subject: time to event models
parts:
Hello HM group:
I apologize if this question is off topic.
I am looking for examples of time-to-event models (such as the Cox proportional hazards model) that consider a random effect and are fitted through Bayesian Methods.
In WinBUGS software Example section 1, the developers have an example called 'leuk' that shows quite nicely a representative Cox model without random effects.  Any suggestions on where to find examples of a model of this type with random effects would be greatly appreciated.
Thank you,
Paul Rudershausen
